name: Local, monitor, and court-adjacent source bridge for DOJ SLS volatile statuses
nonclaim: A local or monitor source may corroborate, complicate, or lag official federal source signals. Rev0006 records source carrier roles only.

sources.source_owner: City of New Orleans / New Orleans Police Department
sources.source_signal_summary: City page says Judge Susie Morgan officially terminated the NOPD consent decree on November 19, 2025 and notes local regulations intended to sustain reforms. It also lists sustainment-period and court filing materials.

sources.source_owner: Newark Police Consent Decree and Planning Division
sources.source_signal_summary: Local page documents the 2014 findings/report background, 2016 court approval/entry of consent decree, and many monitoring reports/orders, but did not provide a visible final termination signal in rev0006 review.

sources.source_owner: New Jersey Institute for Social Justice
sources.source_signal_summary: NJISJ states that Judge Madeline Cox Arleo ordered the Newark consent decree terminated on November 20, 2025 and that the institute had served as part of the independent monitoring team.

sources.source_owner: U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington
sources.source_signal_summary: Court website notice identifies a September 3, 2025 hearing on motions to approve policy revisions/terminate preliminary injunction and terminate consent decree in United States v. City of Seattle, case 2:12-cv-01282-JLR.

sources.source_owner: U.S. Department of Justice Civil Rights Division
sources.source_signal_summary: DOJ cases page is a common source-family carrier for source-page status labels and document labels; the page footer carries an Updated May 1, 2026 label. Some rows may lag later press-release or order signals.

sources.source_owner: U.S. Department of Justice Office of Public Affairs
sources.source_url: multiple; see doj_sls_official_news_events.rev0005.json and new child-event rows
sources.source_signal_summary: Dated DOJ press releases provide event signals for termination, completion, dismissal/retraction, or motions. They are not dockets or orders.
